subject: Exec snapshot: roadmap & budget sprint launch
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec snapshot: roadmap & budget sprint launch

Team — launching a short sprint to align on targets, guardrails, and scenario commitments for the upcoming QBR and annual plan. High-level goals:

- Produce an "exec snapshot" with topline target bands (base / stretch / downside) by next Friday (4/6).
- Surface required staffing and ramp timing for prioritized roadmap bets.
- Produce a concrete contingency playbook (three contingent actions) tied to trigger metrics.

Deliverables and owners (proposed):
- Finance run-rate & headcount P&L: Laura (attach model)
- Resourcing scenarios & prioritization asks: Marissa (staffing scenarios)
- Executive narrative and QBR agenda: Vivek (agenda + ask list)
- Consolidated exec snapshot and one-pager: Logan (I will assemble)

Timeline: kickoff (today) -> first drafts (4/2) -> leadership review (4/5) -> exec snapshot final (4/6).

Please upload working files to the Planning folder and tag INF-9247. I attached a blank template for the run-rate model (Q1_runrate_model.xlsx) to seed assumptions. If you prefer a different cadence for reviews, call it out now.

Thanks — Logan
Logan Wright
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q1_runrate_model.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 tab - template)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec snapshot: roadmap & budget sprint launch

Thanks Logan — uploading a first pass. Notes below and attached: Q1_runrate_model.xlsx (v0.1).

Quick assumptions I used: current ARR growth pacing at 28% YoY, margins expand modestly with operational efficiencies, reserved capacity commitments reflected as fixed monthly costs, and a conservative ramp for Redwood Dedicated sales bookings. Headcount modeled by function (eng, infra, sales, cs).

Open questions for the team:
- Do we want to include a mid-year hiring freeze scenario? I added a toggle in the model for a partial hiring pause (reduces hiring by 40% over Q2).
- Which line items should we treat as non-deferrable for regulatory/compliance spending? I marked core logging/audit as non-deferrable.

I'll be available today for a quick sync at 11:00 if helpful.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q1_runrate_model.xlsx (spreadsheet, contains assumptions tab and P&L)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec snapshot: roadmap & budget sprint launch

Adding staffing scenarios and the prioritization matrix (attached: staffing_scenarios_v1.xlsx). Key highlights:

- Scenario A (Base): moderate hiring across infra + 15 FTEs in eng to deliver core latency and reliability bets — ~60% probability.
- Scenario B (Stretch): full hiring plan + expanded sales coverage to accelerate Dedicated bookings — requires $X incremental spend.
- Scenario C (Downside): pause non-critical hiring; re-prioritize infra optimizations (cost-focused).

Request: Please flag which features/roadmap bets must remain in-scope under Scenario C. I created a short rubric in the sheet so product owners can mark necessity quickly.

Also flagged a potential sequencing risk: core KV-cache optimization is a blocker for quantization rollout; if delayed, cost savings slip ~12% in our base model.

Attachment: staffing_scenarios_v1.xlsx (staffing by function + impact estimates)

Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec snapshot: roadmap & budget sprint launch

Appreciate the rapid turnaround. A couple of executive-level asks to bake into the snapshot:

1) Target bands should be framed as CEO-friendly slides: "Base = defendable plan", "Stretch = accelerate GTM and Dedicated", "Downside = preserve runway." Keep visuals simple: three bars + bullets.

2) Include a short list (2–3 bullets) of "must protect" investments: (a) Compliance & logs, (b) Serving runtime reliability, (c) Key cloud partnerships.

3) Please add an explicit risk trigger table: metric -> trigger -> action. Example: "Net new Dedicated ARR < $300k/mo for two consecutive months -> pause non-critical hiring + pursue short-term commercial credits."

I've uploaded a draft QBR agenda (Confluence link) and added Sara from Acme for visibility on potential partnership timing — she may surface market signals that affect demand assumptions.

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Product Officer (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: scenario_playbook_v1.pdf (playbook summary)
